title: Pallo Systems names Brightline Fulfillment as fulfillment-center partner
text: AUSTIN - Pallo Systems today announced Brightline Fulfillment as its new fulfillment-center partner for 2026 deployments. Pallo Systems announced Brightline Fulfillment as its new fulfillment-center partner, covering three regional sites. Financial terms were not disclosed.

facts.statement: Pallo Systems announced Brightline Fulfillment as its new fulfillment-center partner for 2026 deployments.
